title: SettingsChanged
description:
`settings.changed`'s and `settings.deleted`'s data, on the `settings` topic: a setting
was set, at `version`, or deleted, from `version`. Read a new value with `settings.get`.

```json
{"key": "theme", "version": 4, "by_device": "Sam MacBook"}
```

by_device.description: The paired device that set or deleted it, when an app-role connection did.

version.description: Its version now, from 1; for `settings.deleted`, the version it was deleted at.
